response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005

assumptions.assumption: "High-rebate" means rebrate strictly greater than 0.0005 (cutoff excluded).
Average net fee rate is computed only over rows where both feerate and rebrate are non-null (NULL arithmetic drops others); SUM over no rows yields NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: High-rebate means rebrate at or above 0.0005 (cutoff included).
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
